title: The Mothman of Point Pleasant — Part 1 of 3

scenes.text: Two couples. One dark road. And something with glowing red eyes that, they said, would not let go.
scenes.narration: Two couples. One dark road. And something with glowing red eyes that, they said, would not let go.

scenes.text: Late on November 15, 1966, Roger and Linda Scarberry and Steve and Mary Mallette drove past an abandoned explosives plant.
scenes.narration: Late on November 15, 1966, Roger and Linda Scarberry and Steve and Mary Mallette drove past an abandoned explosives plant.

scenes.text: They said they saw a grey creature shaped like a man, seven feet tall, with wings and glowing red eyes.
scenes.narration: They said they saw a grey creature shaped like a man, seven feet tall, with wings and glowing red eyes.

scenes.text: They said it followed their car toward town at around 100 miles an hour. They went straight to the sheriff's office.
scenes.narration: They said it followed their car toward town at around 100 miles an hour. They went straight to the sheriff's office.

scenes.text: The next day, the Point Pleasant Register told of a man-sized bird. Newspapers soon called it Mothman.
